tytul: Chocolate plum butter: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for plum butter with chocolate. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to NCHFP, chocolate sauces are low-acid recipes and a risk for botulism, so recipes that can them in a boiling-water canner are especially risky; there are also no tested recipes for canning chocolate sauces in a pressure canner. [T:ACI-632]

akapity: According to Oregon State University Extension, fruit butters can be made from most high-acid fruits, among them plums. [T:ACI-627]
Chocolate is a further addition outside any tested recipe. [T:-]

JarAtlas rule (cautious): the NCHFP warning is about chocolate sauces, not fruit butters, but JarAtlas treats chocolate or cocoa as a low-acid ingredient that is not part of any tested fruit butter. [T:ACI-632]
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for plum butter with chocolate from a checked source. [T:-]
